description: The chart illustrates a comparison of the composition of two methods (“Ours” and “Standard”) by showing how each is divided among three labeled components. The category axis is vertical, listing two categories in order from top to bottom as “Ours” and “Standard,” and the value axis is horizontal and represents percentage share (a 0–100% linear scale is implied by the full-length stacked bars, though numeric tick marks are not shown). Each category is represented by a single horizontal stacked bar segmented into three color-coded parts according to the legend: Context (blue), Generated Response (orange), and Other (green). For “Ours,” the blue Context segment is labeled 60.6%, the orange Generated Response segment is labeled 31.7%, and the green Other segment is labeled 7.7%. For “Standard,” the blue Context segment is labeled 23.6%, the orange Generated Response segment is labeled 51.1%, and the green Other segment is labeled 25.3%. The stacking is arranged left-to-right in the same order (Context, then Generated Response, then Other) for both bars, and the segments contain percentage annotations; there is no indication that the categories are sorted by value, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the internal labels.
